text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`: I don't have a shell in this session. I checked each fix by reading it against the tests, so please run the suite to confirm everything passes.

- `search.py`: the import pointed to a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`); it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`.
- `books.py`: `parse_book` left the year as text; it now converts it to an integer, so `age()` works.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` returned one event too many; it now returns the last `n` (an empty list if `n` is zero or less).
- `factory.py`: the sample catalog was missing `Emma` (Austen, 1815), which it now includes.
- `members.py`: the borrowing limit was 3; it's now 5, matching the tests and the comment above it.
- `fees.py`: the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days instead of multiplying by it; it now multiplies.

I didn't change any tests.
